in_sanskrit.name: Rn
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Water, Rain
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Rn एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Rn is derived from the Sanskrit root 'rn' which means 'water' or 'rain'. This name evokes images of the life-giving forces of nature and is often associated with purification, renewal, and transformation.
